title_zh: 郎平：「铁榔头」的教练之路
title_en: Famous Chinese People (5/20): Lang Ping, the Iron Hammer Turned Coach
note_en: English says "under her leadership," with "under" in front, but Chinese wraps the phrase: 在她的带领下 (zài tā de dàilǐng xià), literally "at her leadership's underneath." 在 opens the frame and 下 "under" closes it, and the whole block goes before the main clause: 在她的带领下，中国女排…获得了金牌. The same pattern gives 在…的帮助下 "with the help of."
